sections.product_liability: Chapter VI, Section 84 — Liability of product manufacturer
sections.dealer_liability: Section 86 — Liability of product service provider / dealer
sections.complaint_filing: Section 35 — Manner in which complaint shall be made
sections.relief_remedies: Section 39 — Findings of District Commission and orders
sections.limitation_period: Section 69 — 2-year limitation period from date of cause of action

District Commission.description: District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (claims up to Rs 50 Lakhs)

State Commission.description: State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (claims from Rs 50 Lakhs up to Rs 2 Crores)

National Commission.description: National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (NCDRC) (claims exceeding Rs 2 Crores)

transmission_failure.title: Transmission & Powertrain Systemic Defect
remedies: Full refund with 18% interest per annum
Compensation for mental agony and loss of use
transmission_failure.benchmark_citations: Tata Motors Ltd. v. Rajesh Tyagi & Anr. (NCDRC) — Recurring powertrain defects warrant full vehicle replacement.

brake_engine_hazard.title: Braking / Steering / Engine Thermal Runaway Hazard
remedies: Exemplary punitive damages under Section 39(1)(d) CPA
brake_engine_hazard.benchmark_citations: Maruti Udyog Ltd. v. Susheel Kumar Gabgotra (Supreme Court of India) — Defective parts rendering vehicle unsafe must be remedied or vehicle replaced.

electrical_fire_hazard.title: High Voltage Battery / Electrical Harness / Short Circuit Hazard
remedies: Reimbursement of safety inspection and storage costs
electrical_fire_hazard.benchmark_citations: Section 84(1)(c) CPA 2019 — Defect in design and failure to conform to express warranty of vehicle safety.

structural_chassis_defect.title: Chassis Rusting / Subframe Misalignment / Airbag Failure
structural_chassis_defect.benchmark_citations: Section 2(10) & 84 CPA 2019 — Structural defect in design or deviation from manufacturing specifications.

chronic_unresolved_glitch.title: Recurring Chronic Glitches (>3 Repair Attempts or >30 Days Off Road)
remedies: Compensation for downtime and taxi/commute expenses
chronic_unresolved_glitch.benchmark_citations: Hyundai Motor India Ltd. v. Shailendra Bhatnagar (Supreme Court of India, 2022) — Recurring failure to rectify inherent manufacturing defect constitutes deficiency of service.

mandatory_clauses: Statement of vehicle identity (VIN, Engine No, Invoice, Reg No)
Chronological ledger of job cards and repair attempts
Statutory notice under Section 84 and 35 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019
Formal demand for cure/replacement/refund within 15 days
Notice of intention to approach competent Consumer Commission with costs and exemplary damages
